samples.summary: New 'a merged block may not straddle a freeze boundary' guard (planPasteMerges / moveRangeTo via crossesFreezePane) is bypassed by Sheet.setFreezePane and by the freeze adjustment inside the row/column insert-delete path, both of which can still produce straddling merges
samples.evidence: packages/sheets/src/model/worksheet/sheet.ts:514 `setFreezePane(frozenRows, frozenCols)` writes the new freeze position with no check against `this.merges`, so freezing row N under an existing A(N):A(N+1) block creates exactly the state the diff now refuses on paste (`merge-paste-frozen`) and drag-move (`merge-move-frozen`). Same hole at sheet.ts:1327-1371: `shiftMergeMap` translates the merge map and then the freeze region is grown (`this.frozenRows = frozen + count`, sheet.ts:1350-1356) or shrunk (sheet.ts:1360-1368) without re-checking whether a block now spans the boundary. Reachable UI entry points: view/worksheet.ts:467 `setFreezePane`, the freeze-drag handlers at view/worksheet.ts:1384/1389 and the header menu at view/worksheet.ts:2974/2976, plus remote writes through packages/frontend/src/app/spreadsheet/yorkie-store.ts:1146. docs/design/sheets/sheet.md:277 states the invariant flatly ("Merges that cross freeze pane boundaries are disallowed"), and the new code's own comments say the renderer assumes it when painting a frozen pane and the body from a single block — so the guard the diff adds is only half the enforcement. Fix belongs on `setFreezePane` / the shiftAxis freeze adjustment, not on the new paste code.

samples.summary: Dropping clearCopyBuffer() from both view paste paths leaves getCopyRange()/isCutMode() set indefinitely, and the overlay's copy-range consumer will paint that range after structural edits that shift everything under it
samples.evidence: packages/sheets/src/view/overlay.ts:783/814-822 draws the marching-ants border straight from `copyRange` supplied at view/worksheet.ts:5600-5601. With the unconditional `clearCopyBuffer()` removed from view/worksheet.ts:4947 and view/spreadsheet.ts:728, the only clearing paths left are the grid Escape handler (view/worksheet.ts:5113-5121) and the cut-consumed branch inside `Sheet.paste` (model/worksheet/sheet.ts:2286). Nothing invalidates `copyBuffer.sourceRange` on structural change: sheet.ts:1327 shifts `this.merges`, `rangeStyles`, filter and hidden state on insert/delete but never touches the copy buffer, so after copy → insert rows the overlay keeps outlining cells that are no longer the copied ones. Additionally `Spreadsheet` (view/spreadsheet.ts) exposes no clear entry point of its own, so an embedder using `Spreadsheet.paste()` without the grid keydown focused has no way to dismiss the buffer. The data half of the stale-buffer problem is the correctness lens's; this is the view consumer left out of step.

verdict.reason: Verified in-tree. sheet.ts:514-518 `setFreezePane` writes frozenRows/frozenCols with no check against `this.merges` or `crossesFreezePane`; the new predicate (sheet.ts:2500-2510) is used only at sheet.ts:2430 (merge-paste-frozen), sheet.ts:2687-2693 (merge-move-frozen) and sheet.ts:4678 (canMergeSelection), none of which are on the freeze-setting path. Every assignment of frozenRows/frozenCols repo-wide (sheet.ts:515/516/525/526/1352/1354/1364/1366, memory.ts:666, worksheet-structure.ts:260/262) is unguarded, so no `already-guarded` ground exists. Reachable UI entry points confirmed: view/worksheet.ts:467-474, 1384, 1389, 2974/2976 and view/spreadsheet.ts:118-120 — freezing row N under an existing A(N):A(N+1) block creates exactly the state the diff now refuses on paste and drag-move. The invariant is documented as global, not paste-local (docs/design/sheets/sheet.md:277 and 110-115), and the renderer really does paint per clipped quadrant (view/gridcanvas.ts:260-400), so a straddling block renders from a clipped pane. This is in the blast-radius lane (new guard with another entry point reaching the protected state / invariant other modules assume) and major under the rubric. I could not independently reproduce a straddle from the shiftCells freeze adjustment (sheet.ts:1345-1371) alone — the freeze and merge shift appeared to move in step in the cases I traced — but that is a secondary sub-claim; the setFreezePane bypass is real and sufficient.

finding.summary: New "a merged block may not straddle a freeze boundary" invariant has bypasses outside the diff (`setFreezePane`, freeze adjust on insert/delete, XLSX import), and blocks created that way are now permanently unmovable
finding.evidence: The diff makes freeze-straddling a hard refusal on two paths (`planPasteMerges` → 'merge-paste-frozen', `moveRangeTo` → 'merge-move-frozen'). Out-of-diff writers of the same state are unguarded: `Sheet.setFreezePane` (packages/sheets/src/model/worksheet/sheet.ts:514) sets frozenRows/frozenCols with no check against `this.merges`, the freeze auto-adjustment inside the insert/delete path (sheet.ts:1346-1371) grows/shrinks the frozen region while `shiftMergeMap` (sheet.ts:1327) shifts blocks independently, and the importer writes merges directly (packages/sheets/src/import/xlsx-importer.ts:259 → packages/sheets/src/model/workbook/worksheet-structure.ts:343). Consequence of the new guard: a block that reached a straddling position that way can no longer be drag-moved or pasted at all — every attempt is refused with 'merge-move-frozen'/'merge-paste-frozen', so the user cannot even move it out of the boundary. The project's own task note acknowledges the bypass as "not taken" (docs/tasks/active/20260912-sheets-paste-merge-propagation-todo.md:122). Fix belongs either on `setFreezePane` (reject/unmerge straddlers) or by relaxing the new refusal when the block already straddles.

verdict.reason: All cited code is present as described. The diff-side guards exist (sheet.ts:2425-2433 'merge-paste-frozen'; sheet.ts:2680-2695 'merge-move-frozen', both using crossesFreezePane at sheet.ts:2500-2510). The claimed bypasses are also real and unguarded: Sheet.setFreezePane (sheet.ts:514-518) writes frozenRows/frozenCols with no reference to this.merges, and is reachable from the UI freeze-handle drag (view/worksheet.ts:2968-2977) and view/worksheet.ts:1384-1390 through view/worksheet.ts:467-471, neither of which checks merges; the insert/delete freeze adjustment (sheet.ts:1345-1371) resizes the frozen region while merges are shifted independently at sheet.ts:1327; and the XLSX importer writes merges directly with only a span>1 filter (import/xlsx-importer.ts:240-263). So an entry point outside the diff can reach exactly the state the new guards refuse, i.e. a guard with a reachable bypass / an invariant other modules (the renderer, canMergeSelection at sheet.ts:4678) assume, which the blast-radius rubric grades major. One detail of the finding is overstated: both guards test the translated destination range, so a straddling block CAN still be moved or pasted to a non-straddling location; it is not permanently unmovable, only un-nudgeable while it still straddles. That trims the impact wording but does not make the code 'not present', unreachable, or out of lane, so it is not a ground for refutation.

mergedFrom.summary: Copy buffer now survives pastes, but no structural edit invalidates or shifts `copyBuffer.sourceRange`/`merges`, so a repeat paste after an insert/delete/undo relocates (and now re-creates merges) from stale coordinates

finding.summary: Both view paste paths stopped clearing the copy buffer, so `copyBuffer` now lives indefinitely — but no structural edit invalidates or shifts it, so a later paste relocates from a stale source range and stale merge snapshot
finding.evidence: `copyBuffer = undefined` now only happens in `clearCopyBuffer` (sheet.ts:2141, reached solely from the Escape keybinding at packages/sheets/src/view/worksheet.ts:5118) and on a consumed cut (sheet.ts:2286). Nothing in `insertRows`/`deleteRows` (`shiftMergeMap`, sheet.ts:1327) or `moveCells` (sheet.ts:1516) shifts or drops `copyBuffer.sourceRange` / `copyBuffer.merges`. After copy → insert rows → Ctrl+V (clipboard text unchanged), `paste` still takes the internal branch and computes `deltaRow/deltaCol` (sheet.ts:2250) and `planPasteMerges`' destination range from a source range that no longer describes the data, mis-relocating formulas and applying a stale merge layout. The marching-ants overlay at packages/sheets/src/view/worksheet.ts:5600 renders the same stale `getCopyRange()` indefinitely. Previously the view cleared the buffer right after each paste, which bounded this window to a single paste.

verdict.reason: All claimed facts verified in the repository. Both view paste paths no longer clear the buffer (view/worksheet.ts:4941-4947 with an explicit comment, view/spreadsheet.ts:724-728). Repo-wide grep shows clearCopyBuffer (sheet.ts:2140) has exactly one caller, the Escape keybinding at view/worksheet.ts:5117-5119; the only other reset is the consumed-cut path at sheet.ts:2286. Critically, neither shiftCells (sheet.ts:1293-1334) nor moveCells (sheet.ts:1485-1534) touches copyBuffer, even though both remap every other positionally-anchored piece of state (rangeStyles, merges at 1327/1516, conditionalFormats, dataValidations, filter/hidden state, activeCell at 1522, ranges at 1527). The stale path is reachable: with the clipboard text unchanged, paste takes the internal branch (sheet.ts:2243) and computes deltaRow/deltaCol from copyBuffer.sourceRange[0] (sheet.ts:2250-2251), passes the stale sourceRange and stale merge snapshot to planPasteMerges (sheet.ts:2258-2265), and on a cut derives cutSourceRange/buildCutRefMap from it (sheet.ts:2279-2284), which drives source-cell deletion at coordinates that now hold different data. The overlay renders the stale getCopyRange() at view/worksheet.ts:5600 until Escape. This is squarely in the blast-radius lane: an invariant (the copy buffer's coordinates are never re-anchored by structural edits) that was previously bounded to a single paste by the view, now unbounded, with the maintaining code absent from the diff. No refutation ground applies: the code is present as described, no guard makes it unreachable, and the consequence (wrong relocation target, stale merge layout, wrong cut-source deletion) is a major-severity broken site.

finding.summary: Row/column reorder (`moveCells`) relocates merged blocks with no freeze-straddle check, bypassing the invariant this PR newly enforces in `planPasteMerges` and `moveRangeTo`
finding.evidence: `moveCells` at packages/sheets/src/model/worksheet/sheet.ts:1465 validates only `isMergeSplitByMove` (line 1478-1483) and then translates every block wholesale via `this.merges = moveMergeMap(...)` (line 1516) — no `crossesFreezePane` call. With `frozenRows = 2` and a block at rows 5-6, dragging those rows to index 2 lands the block on rows 2-3, exactly the state the new `merge-paste-frozen` / `merge-move-frozen` refusals (sheet.ts:2430, 2685) declare undrawable because the renderer paints the frozen pane and the body from one block. Same shape for `shiftMergeMap` on insert/delete at sheet.ts:1327, though the freeze-count adjustment at 1347-1371 mitigates most of those cases. The fix belongs on `moveCells`, not on the new paste code.

verdict.reason: Verified in the repo. The freeze-straddle invariant is newly enforced in planPasteMerges (sheet.ts:2429-2433, refusal 'merge-paste-frozen') and moveRangeTo (sheet.ts:2685-2695, refusal 'merge-move-frozen'), both via crossesFreezePane (sheet.ts:2500-2510), and it is also gated at merge creation (sheet.ts:4678). moveCells (sheet.ts:1465-1550) validates only isMergeSplitByMove (1478-1483) — which per merging.ts:181-195 rejects merely partial clipping — and then relocates every wholly-contained block via moveMergeMap at sheet.ts:1516; merging.ts has no freeze awareness at all (grep for frozen|freeze in merging.ts: no matches), and moveCells never adjusts frozenRows/frozenCols. The path is reachable: moveRows/moveColumns (sheet.ts:1279-1288) are public and invoked from the drag-reorder handler at view/worksheet.ts:4656-4659, whose only precondition (worksheet.ts:4649-4654) is the no-op drop check; computeDropIndex (worksheet.ts:4606-4626) does not clamp drops to one side of the freeze boundary. So with frozenRows=2, dragging a merged block at rows 5-6 to index 2 yields rows 2-3, and crossesFreezePane returns true — the exact state the new code calls undrawable. The secondary shiftMergeMap note (sheet.ts:1327) is also accurate, and is indeed mitigated by the freeze-count adjustment at sheet.ts:1346-1371, which moveCells lacks. No guard elsewhere makes this unreachable; the finding is in the blast-radius lane (new guard with a bypassing entry point) and blocking at major.
